days.mbo_verdict: HELP (strong - this is the block's over-size correction). The blind called +900 UP to the close; the MBO shows the up-leg DID deliver intraday (peak +600 at 13:04, blind's leg-direction right) but ROUND-TRIPPED to flat (close -60). The MECHANICAL CAUSE is visible in the flow: the entire up-leg ran on ABSORPTION - phase2 signed-flow -3175 NEGATIVE while price rose +390 - so it was short-covering into a selling tape with no buy conviction, which is exactly why it could not hold. Posterior resizes the DAY NET from +900 to ~flat (-50) and reclassifies continuation->REVERSAL with a ~13:00 turn. WHERE MBO COULD HURT (reported honestly): the raw onset_dir=UP and the absorb=True flag are the SAME signatures that appear on 0319 (which resolved down) - taken naively they would CONFIRM the over-sized up call. The signal that actually saves the day is signed-flow-vs-price direction (negative flow under a rising price = doomed up-leg), not onset or the absorb flag alone. This is the same conclusion the state-based refine reached structurally (shoulder_counter_print_damping), but the MBO SHOWS the round-trip mechanically rather than inferring it.

Counter-print + no seasonal amplifier -> the up-leg delivers then round-trips; specialist D's flow-conviction read (absorption) is the decisive discriminator vs the blind's chain-sided-print assumption.

specialist_summary.principle_check: Both posteriors START from the immutable blind and adjust only on material MBO evidence; neither is a from-scratch order-flow forecast. 0319 = confirm+deepen (small adjustment); 0326 = the material override (day-net +900 -> flat), justified by the absorption/round-trip causal signature.
specialist_summary.eia_lens_finding: The Thursday-print day splits cleanly into pre-print positioning vs post-print reaction, and the MBO makes the split legible. The DECISIVE discriminator between a print that DELIVERS its band (0319, chain-sided) and one that ROUND-TRIPS (0326, counter-print) is signed-flow-vs-price CONVICTION on the post-print leg, NOT the print direction or the onset/absorb flags. 0319: post-print down-leg had flow behind the break (phase3 sflow -1438, px -880 aligned) -> delivered, deeper than blind. 0326: post-print up-leg had flow AGAINST it (phase2 sflow -3175, px +390 = absorption) -> round-tripped to flat.
specialist_summary.mbo_helped_or_hurt_net: HELP on both days. 0319: HELP (magnitude deeper -800->-1050, timing back-loaded, pre-print +470 probe surfaced). 0326: HELP strongly (over-size correction +900->flat via the absorption tell). The honest HURT risk: raw onset_dir and the absorb=True flag are ambiguous - identical on both days yet resolving oppositely - so they must NOT be used as standalone confirmers; only signed-flow-vs-price disambiguates. A naive MBO reader who trusted onset/absorb would have held the over-sized +900 on 0326.
specialist_summary.cutoff_compliance: No post-10:30-ET evidence was used to characterize pre-print positioning on either day. 0319 pre-print reads (onset 00:50 down, +470 probe/turn 09:31) are all pre-print; 0326 pre-print reads (onset 04:34 up, 09:05-10:05 sell-coil) are all pre-print. The +600 high (0326, 13:04) and both evening lows are post-print and used only for the post-print horizon.
specialist_summary.per_event_no_averaging: The two days are characterized individually and resolve oppositely (chain-sided vs counter-print); no pooled 'Thursday' number is asserted.
